headline: Little family traditions to start, based on the day of the week
items: Tuesday — a no-plans night, pajamas on by six
Thursday — a walk to wherever the good light is, camera or not
Saturday — a date night where they pick their big-person outing
Every night — the same lullaby, the one you wrote just for them

cta.eyebrow: Any lullaby can become something special.
cta.ask: But a song made just for *them* will unlock feelings you never knew you had
